blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
blocks.zh: 我们怎样才能建立一种超越人类语言,而仍在外部环境中通过它行事的代理人呢? 现代LLM代理商仍然通过文本进行理性和互动,而潜在的推理则提供了高效的内部介质,但缺乏本土工具访问和推理透明度. 我们用混合理性代理(HybridAgents)将这两个方向相接,在整个统一的生成过程中,这些代理在潜在推理和基于文本的互动之间动态地导航。 在结构上,一个轻量级的HybridLink可以在文本和潜伏模式之间实现无缝的过渡,而代理的连续工作内存则保存了跨多转弯的无损杂交环境. 这些设计保留了工具集成剂能力,同时使潜想可以直接检查。 基于这一架构,我们进一步发展了用于混合推理的专用培训后算法: HybridSFT通过教主干线与HybridLink相协调来稳定工具-集成混合生成,然后HybridRL通过学习何时在潜在空间思考和何时通过文本采取行动来进行规模推理. 我们以3个模型尺度评价混合体,涉及数学、科学、医学、搜索和代理推理等11个基准。 与涵盖文字和潜在方法的前沿LLM代理和代理框架相比,混合代理公司不断提高性能10.4%,同时实现35.5%-54.7%的象征性减排,1.8x-2.6x更快的推论,以及2.7x-3.7x成本节约。 代码和数据见https://github.com/couplecomputer/HybridAgent。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Frontier intelligence no longer scales through the model’s reasoning alone, but depends increasingly on its ability to interact with the external world ( Team, 2026 ; Kwa et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) .
To solve a hard problem, an LLM agent must reach beyond the model itself by continually invoking specialized tools, observing feedback from the environment, and adapting its next move ( Qu et al., 2025 ; Silver and Sutton, 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) .
Beneath this expanding repertoire of agent harnesses lies a single lingua franca: text , the common medium of both the agent’s autoregressive generation and its environment interaction ( Sumers et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) .
All intermediate reasoning trajectories are generated token by token as text before the agent can act on the environment.
blocks.zh:
边疆情报不再仅仅通过模型的推理来进行规模化,而是越来越依赖于其与外界互动的能力(Team,2026;Kwa等,2026;Sun等,2026).
为了解决一个棘手的问题,LLM剂必须超越模型本身,不断利用专门工具,观察环境反馈,并调整其下一步(Qu等,2025;Silver和Sutton,2025;Feng等,2026)。
在这种不断扩展的毒剂捕捉器背后,有一个单一的通用语:正文,即毒剂自递生成及其环境相互作用的共同媒介(Sumers等,2024;Zhang等,2026b)。
所有中间推理轨迹都是在代理者能够对环境采取行动之前以符号形式作为文本生成的.

blocks.en:
A separate line of work on latent reasoning points in a different direction ( Zhu et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .
By unfolding computation directly in continuous hidden space, latent models bypass the need to decode and verbalize every intermediate step, providing more efficient internal reasoning within the model’s “own language" ( Hao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) .
However, today’s latent reasoners remain largely sealed behind the model boundary.
Unlike decoded text, continuous latent vectors (i) lack native pathways for tool invocation across multi-turn agentic reasoning ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , and (ii) do not readily expose human-interpretable semantics, leaving them difficult to supervise during training ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and to audit or debug at inference ( Korbak et al., 2025 ) .
These constraints keep latent reasoning models from operating as capable agents in their own right.
blocks.zh:
关于潜在推理点的单独工作方向不同(Zhu等人,2025年b; 陈等,2025. ).
通过在连续的隐蔽空间中直接进行计算,潜在模型绕过了对每一个中间步骤进行解码和口语化的需要,在模型的"自有语言"中提供了更有效的内部推理(Hao等,2024;Wang等,2025;Yu等,2026).
然而,今天的潜在原因在很大程度上仍然被封在模型边界后。
与解码文本不同的是,持续的潜伏向量(一) 缺乏在多回合代理推理中引用工具的本土途径(Chan等,2026年),并(二) 不易暴露出由人解释的语义,使其难以在培训期间进行监督(Chen等,2026年)并难以审计或调试推论(Korbak等,2025年)。
这些制约因素使潜在的推理模型本身无法作为有能力的代理人运作。

blocks.en:
Taken together, agentic interaction and efficient inner reasoning have so far required a different medium each, leaving the two lines of work apart in the development of next-generation agents.
We believe this division can be closed by building a new type of agent that combines both strengths to think beyond text while still acting through it . We call this unified design HybridAgent , one that dynamically navigates between latent reasoning and text-based interaction within a single generation.
blocks.zh:
归根结底,代理互动和高效的内在推理迄今为止要求各有不同的介质,使得两条工作线在下一代代理的发展中相去甚远.
我们认为,通过建立一种新类型的代理人来结束这种分裂,这种代理人将两种力量结合起来,思考超越文本,而同时又通过文本采取行动。 我们称之为“统一设计混合代理”,它能在一代人中动态地引导潜在的推理和基于文本的互动。

blocks.en:
Building such an agent is hard, since it needs to handle both dense continuous vectors and sparse discrete tokens as hybrid inputs, and determine when to transition between text and latent modes to balance agentic actions and reasoning efficiency.
To offset the hardness, we first revisit the model architecture and extend its autoregressive generation interface to support hybrid inputs.
At the heart of this design is HybridLink , a lightweight residual adapter that bridges latent thoughts from the last-layer hidden space back into the input embedding space and enables sequence-wise recurrence within latent mode.
Then, we realize multi-turn hybrid generation through the agent’s own working memory, carrying complete hybrid trajectories of text, latent thoughts, and tool observations across turns.
Surprisingly, we find that HybridAgent can render its thoughts in latent mode as human-readable pseudo-text, making latent reasoning transparent and directly inspectable rather than opaque.
blocks.zh:
建立这种代理人是困难的,因为它既需要处理密集的连续向量,也需要处理作为混合输入的稀有离散符号,并确定何时在文本和潜在模式之间过渡,以平衡代理行动和推理效率。
为了抵消硬度,我们首先重新审视了模型架构,并扩展了它的自旋生成接口,以支持混合输入.
这个设计的核心是HybridLink, 一种轻量级的剩余适配器,它把从上一层隐藏空间中潜入的想法接回输入嵌入空间,并使得在潜入模式中能够按顺序重现.
然后,我们通过代理商自己的工作记忆,实现多回合混合生成,并搭载完整的文本、潜想和工具观测的混合轨迹。
令人惊讶的是,我们发现“混合代理人”能够将其思想变成人可读取的伪文字的潜在模式,使潜在推理变得透明并可以直接检查,而不是不透明。

blocks.en:
To further unlock the potential of hybrid reasoning, we equip HybridAgent with dedicated post-training algorithms. HybridSFT first stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation through activation and self-conditioned training, which adapts the backbone to reason over latent thoughts produced by its own HybridLink, enabling reliable coordination between the two components and closing the train-inference mismatch.
Then, HybridRL scales agentic reasoning capabilities by training HybridAgent to adaptively balance latent reasoning and text-based interaction. To realize this, we enable policy optimization over hybrid trajectories through hybrid policy factorization and exact rollout replay.
blocks.zh:
为了进一步解开混合推理的潜力,我们为HybridAgent配备了专门的训练后算法. HybridSFT首先通过激活和自备条件的训练来稳定工具集成的混合生成,这种训练使骨干适应了由它自己的HybridLink产生的理性过深的思想,使得两个组件之间能够进行可靠的协调并关闭了列车推论不匹配.
然后,混合 RL通过训练混合代理人来适应性地平衡潜在推理和以文字为基础的相互作用,从而对代理推理能力进行分级. 为了实现这一点,我们通过混合政策要素化和确切的再推出,使政策在混合轨道上得到优化。

blocks.en: We provide theoretical grounding for HybridAgent through complementary analyses of multi-turn context continuation and hybrid policy optimization. From an architectural standpoint, we show that continuous working memory losslessly preserves the entire hybrid context across different turns. From a learning perspective, the hybrid policy factorization and exact latent-context replay in HybridRL provide a well-founded basis for policy updates over complete hybrid trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对多回合环境持续和混合政策优化进行互补分析,为混合代理人提供理论基础。 从建筑的角度看,我们显示,连续的工作记忆毫无损失地保留了整个混合背景,跨越不同的转折。 从学习的角度来看,混合政策要素化和在混合资源保护机制中确切的潜在文字重放,为在完整的混合轨道上更新政策提供了坚实的基础。

blocks.en:
Empirically, we evaluate HybridAgent on 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, knowledge-intensive search, and challenging agentic reasoning.
We instantiate and train HybridAgent with Qwen3-Base models ( Yang et al., 2025a ) across 4B, 8B, and 14B scales.
Compared with frontier LLM agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent reasoning, HybridAgent achieves an average performance improvement of 10.4% and exhibits strong test-time scalability. In terms of efficiency, HybridAgent reduces token usage by 35.5%–54.7%, delivers 1.8 × \times –2.6 × \times inference speedup, and lowers computational cost by 2.7 × \times –3.7 × \times .
Additional in-depth analyses of training dynamics, reasoning auditability, and agentic tool-use reliability reveal a clear division of labor between the two reasoning modes: HybridAgent shifts more internal reasoning into semantically rich and interpretable latent thoughts, while reserving text for external inspection and tool interaction.
blocks.zh:
从经验上讲,我们评价混合代理人的11个基准,包括数学、科学、医学、知识密集型搜索和具有挑战性的代理推理。
我们利用Qwen3-Base模型(Yang等人,2025a)对混合代理人进行即时和培训,跨越4B、8B和14B等尺度。
与涵盖文本和潜在推理的前沿LLM代理人和代理框架相比,混合代理人的平均性能提高了10.4%,并显示出强大的测试时间可扩展性。 在效率方面,HybridAgent将信使使用率减少了35.5~54.7%,交付了1.8x\times – 2.6x\times推算速度,并降低了2.7xxxtimes – 3.7x\times的计算成本.
对培训动态、推理可审计性以及代理工具使用可靠性进行的其他深入分析揭示了两种推理模式之间的明确分工: " 混合代理人 " 将更多的内部推理转化为内容丰富和可解释的潜在思想,同时保留文字供外部检查和工具互动。

3 Building a Hybrid Reasoning Agent

blocks.en:
We introduce HybridAgent, a hybrid framework that dynamically navigates between explicit text and continuous latent reasoning within a single unified generation process.
As illustrated in Figure 1 , the architecture preserves an LLM agent’s autoregressive generation and tool-calling interfaces while accommodating both text and latent inputs.
Below, we first present the hybrid interface for seamless text-latent mode transition (Section 3.1 ), followed by multi-turn hybrid generation (Section 3.2 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Hybrid Mode Interface
blocks.zh: 3.1 混合模式接口

blocks.en:
Existing latent reasoning models typically feed the last-layer hidden state h t h_{t} directly back as the next-step input e t + 1 e_{t+1} .
This design is not well suited to hybrid generation, as substituting h t h_{t} for a token embedding creates a representation mismatch with the pretrained input space, making transitions between continuous latent states and discrete tokens difficult.
To support both latent and text modes in a shared input interface, we add a lightweight adapter HybridLink to work alongside the backbone.

为了支持共享输入界面中的潜在模式和文本模式,我们添加了轻量级适配器HybridLink来配合主干线工作.

blocks.en: Dynamic Text-Latent Mode Transition. Next, we describe how HybridAgent transitions between text and latent modes during generation, together with the entry and exit decisions for each mode.

blocks.en: In text mode, HybridAgent behaves exactly as a standard LLM, sampling the next token from the vocabulary at each step. The process continues until the agent generates one special token <latent> , which serves as the entry anchor for the latent mode. For the next forward pass, the agent uses HybridLink for latent reasoning in place of the LM head and token embedding layer.

blocks.en:
In standard LLM agents, each turn’s generated content and tool outputs are appended to the textual context and re-encoded as the next turn’s input prefix.
Hybrid trajectories, however, interleave text tokens with latent vectors and can’t be reconstructed through conventional tokenization alone. Instead, HybridAgent carries the complete context across turns through its continuous working memory.

blocks.en: 4 Learning to Perform Hybrid Reasoning

blocks.en:
With the overall framework in place, we now turn to training.
As HybridAgent leaves the backbone architecture intact, no pre-training from scratch is required. Instead, we adapt the standard agentic post-training pipeline of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to the hybrid setting. The two training stages serve complementary roles: SFT teaches the agent to coordinate with HybridLink and instantiate reliable tool use for stable hybrid generation (Section 4.1 ), while RL further scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text (Section 4.2 ).

Hybrid Data Recipe. To curate high-quality training data, we filter existing text-based agentic SFT datasets from multiple sources and convert them into hybrid trajectories through automatic annotation.

blocks.en:
A HybridAgent cannot straightforwardly adopt popular RL algorithms such as PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) or GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , as they assume every generated position carries a token-level likelihood.

We address this incompatibility with two simple components.

Policy Update via Exact Rollout Replay. Policy optimization generally involves rebuilding a differentiable computation graph for the rollouts.
Applying this to HybridAgent further requires recomputing sampled text-token likelihoods conditioned on the same preceding latent thoughts used during rollout.
We satisfy this requirement via exact latent-context replay .
During hybrid rollout, we record latent thoughts alongside sampled text tokens and tool observations.
During policy updates, we replay the full hybrid trajectory in embedding space with a single differentiable forward pass, keeping the recorded latent inputs unchanged while recomputing the sampled likelihoods in Eq. 10 .

Algorithm 1 outlines the full HybridRL training procedure. We keep the HybridLink fixed to preserve deterministic latent transitions.
For the reward design, we simply formulate it as: r ⁡ ( τ ) = r correct + r format + r tool , r(\tau)=r_{\mathrm{correct}}+r_{\mathrm{format}}+r_{\mathrm{tool}}, (11) where r correct r_{\mathrm{correct}} measures answer correctness, r format r_{\mathrm{format}} penalizes invalid formatting, and r tool r_{\mathrm{tool}} encourages multi-tool use.
We impose no explicit reward for mode usage, allowing HybridAgent to adaptively balance text and latent generation and discover effective hybrid reasoning strategies during RL.

blocks.en:
Main Results. Tables 1 and 2 report the overall performance of HybridAgent across 11 benchmarks spanning math, science, medicine, and knowledge search domains.
On challenging agentic reasoning benchmarks, HybridAgent delivers competitive performance over larger frontier LLM agents and specialized tool-use frameworks, with HybridAgent (14B) improving over the strongest agentic baseline by an average of 17.4%.
In addition, under matched model sizes and training budgets, HybridSFT and HybridRL demonstrate consistent training effectiveness and improve over corresponding text/latent baselines by 18.5% at the SFT stage and 10.4% at the RL stage.
Together, HybridAgent combines the strengths of text-based agentic tool use with faster and more expressive latent reasoning, allowing the agent to interact externally while achieving deeper thinking depth internally.

此外,在匹配的模型规模和培训预算下,SFT和HybridRL在SFT阶段显示一致的培训效力,比相应的文本/相对基线提高18.5%,RL阶段提高10.4%。
HybridAgent将基于文本的代理工具使用的优点与更快,更能表达的潜在推理结合起来,使代理在内部实现更深层次的思维深度的同时,可以进行外部互动.

blocks.zh: 5.2 混合世代的效率优势

blocks.en:
Beyond performance effectiveness, a key architectural advantage of HybridAgent is that latent mode enables efficient generation without costly explicit token decoding.
We evaluate this property empirically along three complementary dimensions: (i) token throughput , (ii) wall-clock inference time , and (iii) actual computation cost .
As shown in Figures 6 and 7 , HybridAgent adaptively balances its hybrid reasoning across text and latent modes by using 2.7 × 2.7\times fewer text tokens, reducing total generation steps by up to 54%, and achieving 2.1 × 2.1\times faster inference than text-based baselines.
Together with the cost analyses in Table 9 (see Appendix G.2 ), HybridAgent generates more concise and refined reasoning trajectories, reducing inference overhead and cost.

除了性能效能外,“混合代理”在建筑方面的一个主要优势是,潜在的模式能够高效生成,而无需花费昂贵的明确符号解码。
我们从经验上按照三个相辅相成的方面来评估这一财产:(一) 象征性的吞吐量;(二) 时钟推断时间;(三) 实际计算成本。
如图6和图7所示,混合代理人通过使用2.7×2.7\时的文字符号来适应性地平衡其跨文本和潜在模式的混合推理,将总生成步骤减少至54%,并比基于文本的基线实现2.1×2.1\时的推论更快.
与表9中的费用分析(见附录G.2)一起,混合剂产生更简洁和精细的推理轨迹,减少了推论的间接费用和成本.

blocks.en: RoadMap. We further analyze HybridAgent from 3 complementary perspectives to assess the method design and better understand its hybrid reasoning behavior. (i) Training Dynamics : We study how self-conditioning in HybridSFT improves reasoning performance (Table 8 ) and latent interpretability (Figure 8 ), and how HybridRL shifts more reasoning into latent mode while strengthening tool interaction (Figure 9 ). (ii) Latent-Mode : We intervene on latent content, ordering, and reasoning depth to examine HybridAgent’s causal reliance on latent thoughts (Table 5 ), and ablate HybridLink architectures to assess the benefits of residual alignment (Table 6 ). (iii) Text-Mode : We evaluate text-based agentic tool use (Figure 10 ) and auditability of HybridAgent (Table 7 ) to verify that text-mode supports reliable environment interaction and remains informative for external monitoring/debugging.

(一) 培训动态:我们研究HybridSFT的自建如何提高推理性能(表8)和潜在可解释性(图8),以及HybridRL如何在加强工具互动的同时将更多的推理转向潜在模式(图9)。 (二) 后期模式: 我们干预潜在内容、顺序和推理深度,以审查混合代理人对潜在思想的因果关系(表5),并废除混合链接架构,以评估剩余调整的好处(表6)。 (三)文本模式:我们评价基于文本的代理工具使用(图10)和混合代理的可审计性(表7),以核实文本模式支持可靠的环境互动,并保持对外部监测/调试的信息。

Self-Conditioning Enables Effective and Interpretable HybridSFT. To understand why self-conditioned training is necessary for HybridAgent during SFT, we compare HybridSFT against variants with only format and HybridLink activations as well as latent SFT baselines like Coconut, from both performance and interpretability perspectives.
As shown in Table 8 , although all SFT variants improve the original shared Qwen3-14B-Base backbone, activation alone remains insufficient. Self-conditioned supervision further improves performance by an average of 30.5% over HybridLink activation, bringing HybridSFT to parity with standard text SFT across all three math benchmarks.

如表8所示,尽管所有的SFT变体都改进了原有的共享的Qune3-14B-Base主干线,但单是激活还是不够的. 自备性监督在HybridLink活化率上进一步提高了平均30.5%的性能,使得HybridSFT在所有三个数学基准上与标准文本SFT达到等同.

blocks.en:
We further probe the semantics of the latent thoughts produced by each method over 200 questions spanning all downstream domains.
Figure 8 reveals a clear progression, where HybridLink activation first makes latent contents more interpretable, and the additional self-conditioned training sharpens the latent readability and semantic informativeness.
We then take a closer look to examine individual test instances through detailed case studies in Appendix J .
Specifically, methods with low faithfulness and specificity generally produce largely unreadable artifacts of the embedding geometry, whereas the complete HybridSFT yields clear and semantically coherent latent readouts.
Overall, these analyses reveal that self-conditioned training is essential to HybridSFT for making the latent reasoning traces in HybridAgent fully transparent and directly interpretable.

我们进一步探究了每种方法所产生的潜伏思想的语义学,涉及下游所有领域的200个问题。

然后,我们通过附录J中的详细个案研究,仔细研究个别试验案例。
具体地说,低忠诚度和特异性的方法一般会产生嵌入几何学的基本上无法读取的文物,而完整的HybridSFT则产生清晰而相通的潜在读取.
总的来说,这些分析表明,自备条件的培训对于 " 混合金融电信系统 " 使 " 混合金融电信系统 " 中的潜在推理痕迹完全透明和可直接解释至关重要。

In Figure 9 , as the training step increases, our 14B agent progressively allocates more generation to latent mode while simultaneously strengthening its tool-invocation capability.
Through training, HybridAgent adaptively learns to better utilize its two modes, shifting more reasoning into faster latent thinking while selectively exposing only key steps for external auditing and tool use through the text interface.

Reward Shaping in HybridRL. We ablate each reward component in Eq. 11 using HybridAgent (8B), removing one term at a time under otherwise identical setups.
In Table 4 , all three components provide complementary supervision. Excluding r correct r_{\text{correct}} causes the largest overall degradation, reducing performance by 6.4%-17.8%, while removing r format r_{\text{format}} consistently lowers performance by 4.7%-6.9%.
The benefit of r tool r_{\text{tool}} is most pronounced on agentic benchmarks such as GAIA and WebWalker. Since the reward is granted only to trajectories that invoke both Python and search tools, removing r tool r_{\text{tool}} has a minor effect on MATH500, where Python alone is typically sufficient, but reduces GAIA and WebWalker by 11.2% and 3.5%.
Overall, each reward component provides complementary supervision for answer correctness, format structure, and effective multi-tool use.

blocks.en: Does HybridAgent Causally Rely on its Latent Mode Thoughts? To examine whether latent thoughts are functionally used during hybrid reasoning, we intervene on the latent vectors generated by 8B and 14B HybridAgent on the MATH500 downstream task. We perturb their content, ordering, and reasoning duration through 4 different types of controlled interventions, including (i) noise perturbation , (ii) latent replacement , (iii) latent permutation , and (iv) latent computation restriction . Table 5 details the intervention setups and reports performance under each scenario.
blocks.zh: 混合间谍Causally 是否重温了它的后期模式思想? 为了研究潜伏思想在混合推理过程中是否在功能上被使用,我们介入了由8B和14B混合体代理公司在MATH500下游任务上产生的潜伏向量. 我们通过4种不同类型的控制干预,包括:(一) 噪音扰动、(二) 潜在替换、(三) 潜在穿透和(四) 潜在计算限制,干扰它们的内容、顺序和推理持续时间。 表5详细列出了在每种情况下的干预设置和报告执行情况。

blocks.en:
As shown in the table, disrupting latent thoughts consistently degrades performance across both scales. Specifically, cross-problem and random-token replacement reduce accuracy by 44.9-47.0% and 49.4-51.3%, while disrupting their ordering or restricting each latent span to one step leads to 13.4-15.0% degradation. Notably, cross-problem replacement causes substantially greater degradation than even stronger Gaussian perturbations, suggesting that performance depends on the semantic content of latent thoughts rather than perturbation magnitude alone.
These analysis results on causal interventions indicate that HybridAgent functionally relies on the semantics, ordering, and sufficient reasoning depth of its latent thoughts during hybrid reasoning.
blocks.zh:
如上表所示,破坏潜在思想不断降低两个比额表的业绩。 具体来说,交叉问题和随机重置将精度降低44.9%至4.7%和49.4%至51.3%,而中断其顺序或将每个潜在跨度限制在一步则导致13.4%至1.5.0%的降解。 值得注意的是,交叉问题替换造成的降解程度大大高于更强的高斯扰动,这表明性能取决于潜在思想的语义内涵,而不只是扰动量。
这些对因果干预的分析结果表明,"混合代理人"在功能上依赖于语义,顺序,以及在"混合推理"中其潜伏思想的充分推理深度.

blocks.en: HybridLink Design. We next validate the effectiveness of HybridLink and its residual connection by comparing our adopted 2-layer residual design against 4 alternative architectures: (i) direct hidden-state reuse (i.e., e t + 1 e_{t+1} = = h t h_{t} ) without learned alignment, (ii) 1-layer projection, (iii) 1-layer projection with residual connection, and (iv) 2-layer projection without residual connection. We end-to-end train each HybridLink variant with the 14B backbone under the same setup and evaluate across tasks.
blocks.zh: 混合林克设计. 我们接下来验证HybridLink及其剩余连接的有效性,将我们采用的2层剩余设计与4个替代结构进行比较:(一)直接隐藏状态再利用(即et + 1 e_{t+1}= = h t h_{t}t}),不学习对接,(二)1层投影,(三)1层投影与剩余连接,(四)2层投影与剩余连接. 我们每个HybridLink变体的端到端列车,在相同的设置下拥有14B主干线,并跨任务评价.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Effectiveness of HybridLink. We compare accuracy across alternative architectural designs.
blocks.zh: 表6:混合链接的有效性。 我们比较了其他建筑设计的准确性。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 6 , the full two-layer residual design of HybridLink yields consistent gains across all three downstream benchmarks, with the residual branch benefiting both one- and two-layer projection networks.
Specifically, incorporating the residual connection contributes an average improvement of 4.3% across different layer depths.
This observed trend aligns with our design motivation in Section 3.1 , where the residual connection preserves the semantics of input last-layer hidden states while the learned projection aligns these representations with the input embedding space.
Together, these two components make HybridLink a more effective and stable interface for hybrid training and generation.
blocks.zh:
如表6所示,HybridLink的整个两层残余设计在所有三个下游基准中都取得了一致的收益,其余分支使一层和二层的预测网络都受益。
具体地说,纳入剩余连接有助于不同地层深度的平均改善4.3%。
这一观察到的趋势符合我们在第3.1节中的设计动机,该节中剩余连接保留了输入上一层隐藏状态的语义,而学到的投影则使这些表示与输入嵌入空间相匹配。
这两个组件共同使HybridLink成为混合训练和生成的更有效更稳定的接口.

blocks.en: 6.3 Tool Use and Reasoning Auditability in Text Mode
blocks.zh: 6.3 文本模式中的工具使用和审计理由

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Agentic Tool-Use Analysis on HybridAgent. Left : Valid tool-call rate across 8B and 14B scales; "Execute Success" measures error-free execution among valid tool calls. Middle : Final-answer accuracy on questions where the agent performs at least one tool call. Right : Useful tool-call rate, measuring the fraction of tool calls whose execution results contain the final answer.
blocks.zh: 图10:混合剂的代理工具用途分析。 左边 : 有效的工具调用率跨越8B和14B尺度;"执行成功"在有效的工具调用中衡量了无错误的执行. 中 : 对代理执行至少一个工具调用的问题进行最后准确回答. 对 : 有用的工具调用率,测量其执行结果包含最终答案的工具调用比例.

blocks.en:
Does HybridAgent Text-Mode Preserve Agentic Tool Use? In Figure 10 , we analyze agentic tool-calling capabilities by comparing HybridAgent with normal LLM agents trained on GRPO, examining whether hybrid reasoning preserves reliable external interactions through its text mode.
Across 8B and 14B scales, HybridAgent achieves higher valid tool-call rates while matching the 99.7% execution success of valid calls, showing that hybrid reasoning preserves a reliable text-mode tool interface. More importantly, the gains extend beyond call validity, as HybridAgent improves final-answer accuracy by 2.2%-44.1% on questions where tools are invoked. The 4.5%-7.7% higher useful tool-call rate further indicates that HybridAgent not only invokes tools correctly, but also retrieves evidence that more directly contributes to solving the task.
These findings suggest that HybridAgent preserves the reliable and effective agentic tool use of standard LLM agents through its text mode, while exposing fewer text tokens with interleaved latent reasoning.
blocks.zh:
混合代理文本模式保存代理工具是否使用 ? 在图10中,我们通过比较HybridAgent和接受过GRPO训练的普通LLM代理来分析代理工具调用能力,检查混合推理是否通过其文本模式保留了可靠的外部相互作用.
跨8B和14B尺度,HybridAgent在匹配有效呼叫的99.7%执行成功的同时,实现了更高的有效工具调用率,表明混合推理保存了可靠的文本-模式工具接口. 更重要的是,收益超出了调用有效性,因为混合代理公司在使用工具的问题上将最终答案的准确性提高了2.2%至44.1%。 4.5%-7.7%的有用工具调用率进一步表明"混合代理"不仅正确引用工具,还检索更直接有助于解决任务的证据.
这些发现表明"混合代理"通过它的文本模式保留了标准LLM代理的可靠而有效的代理工具使用,同时暴露出较少的带有相间潜出推理的文本符号.

blocks.en: Does HybridAgent Text-Mode Preserve External Auditability? A natural question of hybrid reasoning is whether shifting computation into latent mode might potentially compromise the external auditability provided by text. To examine this, we evaluate HybridAgent against matched text agents on MATH500 and AIME25/26, covering 560 problems under identical setups. For each question, an external observer sees only the exposed text steps, tool calls, and tool outputs, while latent spans remain hidden behind their boundary markers. We evaluate four complementary dimensions following commonly adopted evaluation protocols. • Monitoring : Measure whether a blind external monitor can predict rollout correctness from the input problem and visible trace generated by each agent, following Baker et al. (2025) . We report AUROC using GPT-4o-mini ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) as a weak monitor, which relies primarily on the visible trace rather than solving the problem independently, and GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as a strong monitor with more powerful task-solving capability. • Debugging : Following first-error localization ( Zheng et al., 2025a ) , a judge model (GPT-5.6-Luna) is deployed to identify the first erroneous visible step from a failed rollout and produces a corrective hint, with the diagnosis verified against the reference ground-truth solution. • Correction : Each failed problem is re-attempted using the corrective hint generated during debugging, and compared against a generic correctness-only feedback baseline ( Huang et al., 2024 ) that simply tells the agent its previous answer was incorrect and asks it to retry. • Rationale Sufficiency : Following sufficiency evaluation in DeYoung et al. (2020) , a weak reader (GPT-4o-mini) predicts the agent’s own answer from the exposed text steps alone after removing the final answer, measuring whether the visible trace retains sufficient decision-relevant information.
blocks.zh: 混合代理文本模式是否保留外部审计? 混合推理的一个自然问题是,将计算转换为潜在模式是否会损害文本提供的外部审计能力。 为了审查这一点,我们在MATH500和AIME25/26上对照匹配的文本代理对混合代理进行了评估,涵盖了相同设置下的560个问题。 对于每个问题,一个外部观察者只看到被曝光的文本步骤,工具呼叫和工具输出,而潜在的跨度仍然隐藏在其边界标记后. 我们按照共同通过的评价议定书评价四个相辅相成的方面。 • 监测:根据Baker等人(2025年),衡量一个盲目的外部监测器是否能够预测每一剂的输入问题和可见的痕量的正确性。 我们报告AUROC使用GPT-4o-mini(Hurst等,2024年)作为弱监测器,主要依靠可见的踪迹而不是独立解决问题,而GPT-5.6-Luna(OpenAI,2026年)作为强监测器,具有更强大的任务解决能力. 二. 支助 调试:在先入为主(郑等,2025a.)后,部署一个裁判模型(GPT-5.6-Luna),以辨别出一个失败推出后的第一个错误可见步骤并产生一个纠正提示,诊断结果与参考地-真相解决方案进行校验. ^ 校正:每个失败的问题都使用调试过程中产生的纠正提示重新尝试,并与一个通用的只有正确性的反馈基准(Huang等,2024)进行比较,该基准只是告诉代理其先前的答案是不正确的,要求代理重试. 二. 支助 理由充足性:在DeYoung等人(2020年)的充足性评价后,一个弱读者(GPT-4o-mini)在去除最终答案后,只从被曝光的文本步骤中预测出代理商自己的答案,衡量可见的踪迹是否保留了足够的决策相关信息.

blocks.en: Table 7: Monitorability and Debuggability through HybridAgent Text-Mode. We compare HybridAgent with matched same-size text agents to examine whether its exposed text remains sufficient for external monitoring, debugging, correction, and rationale-based inspection under hybrid reasoning. All comparisons are evaluated using paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 表7:通过混合代理文本模式进行监测和调试。 我们比较混合代理商与匹配大小相同的文本代理商,以检查其已曝光文本是否仍然足以在混合推理下进行外部监测、调试、校正和基于理由的检查。 所有比较都使用95%的置信间隔进行对接。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 7 , HybridAgent exposes 43%-49% fewer text-mode tokens while performing 170-183 reasoning steps in latent mode, yet the visible trace contains 26%-28% more key reasoning steps per 100 tokens. This reduction preserves external monitorability, with AUROC remaining within 0.022 of matched text agents across both weak and strong monitors. The exposed text also remains debuggable, localizing the first error in 98%-99% of failed rollouts and yielding reference-consistent diagnoses in 97%-98% of cases with below 1% answer leakage. Moreover, text-derived corrective hints produce significant fix-rate gains of 5.4 and 9.1 points at 14B and 8B, while rationale sufficiency remains comparable to or higher than text agents.
As shown by the analyses above, HybridAgent uses its text mode to maintain a compact yet informative textual interface for external monitoring, debugging, and correction.
This provides an important safeguard for agent generation, facilitating human auditing and intervention while preserving efficient internal reasoning.
blocks.zh:
如表7所示,混合代理公司在潜在模式下执行170-183个推理步骤的同时,披露的文本模式符号减少43%-49%,然而可见的痕迹包含每100个符号中26%-28%的关键推理步骤。 这一减少保持了外部的可监测性,AUROC在整个弱和强显示器上的匹配文本代理仍然保持在0.022以内。 已曝光的文本仍可调试,将98%-99%失败的推出中的第一个出错本地化,并在97%-98%的答案不足1%的病例中得出与参考一致的诊断结果。 此外,出自文本的纠正提示在14B和8B产生5.4和9.1分的重大固定率收益,而理由充分性仍与文本代理商相当或高于文本代理商。
如上述分析所示,混合代理公司利用其文本模式维持一个紧凑但内容翔实的文本界面,用于外部监测、调试和校正。
这为代理人的产生提供了重要的保障,便利了人的审计和干预,同时保持了高效的内部推理.

blocks.en: 7 Related Work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Latent Reasoning Beyond Text. Recent works have explored applying intermediate reasoning beyond discrete language tokens into continuous hidden spaces ( Hao et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025a ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , allowing models to perform internal computation without explicitly verbalizing every reasoning step ( Geiping et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025b ) .
Existing approaches broadly realize this idea by inputting last-layer hidden states ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Tack et al., 2026 ) , compressing textual chains of thought into latent representations ( Cheng and Van Durme, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , or directly optimizing continuous reasoning trajectories ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
These methods improve reasoning efficiency and depth but make direct inspection and external interaction difficult ( Korbak et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
HybridAgent builds on this direction by integrating directly inspectable latent reasoning as a native built-in mode within the agentic generation process, while preserving direct text-based auditing and tool interaction.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2012-10-12). Latent Reasoning Beyond Text. 最近的一些著作探讨了将离散语言符号以外的中间推理应用到连续隐藏空间的问题(Hao等,2024;Zhu等,2025a; Yu et al., 2026 ),允许模型在进行内部计算时,不会明确地对每个推理步骤进行口语化(Geiping等,2026;Shen等,2026;Zhu等,2025b.).
通过输入上层隐藏状态(Saunshi等,2025年;Tack等,2026年),将文字思维链压缩为潜在的表达方式,广泛实现这一想法。 (程和范杜尔梅,2024;张等,2026a),或直接优化连续推理轨迹(谭等,2026;陈等,2024.
这些方法提高了推理效率和深度,但使直接检查和外部互动困难重重(Korbak等,2025;Chen等,2026)。
HybridAgent利用这个方向,将可直接检查的潜在推理作为内置模式纳入代理生成过程,同时保持基于文字的直接审计和工具互动。

blocks.en:
Agentic Reasoning and Tool Use. Frontier LLM agents ( Team, 2026 ; GLM-5-Team and others, 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) extend reasoning beyond static generation by interacting with external environments through tools ( Shen, 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) , such as search engines ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) , code interpreters ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Bianchi et al., 2026 ) , and APIs ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2025 ) .
A growing line of work further improves these capabilities through post-training over multi-turn tool-use trajectories ( Dong et al., 2025a ; Qian et al., 2025 ) , enabling agents to plan, act, observe, and revise their reasoning ( Su et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ) .
Despite this progress, existing agentic frameworks remain text-centric for both model-side reasoning and environment-side interaction, incurring large generation overhead from verbalizing every intermediate step ( Cuadron et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) .
HybridAgent decouples these roles by interleaving continuous thoughts for internal reasoning and retaining text only where explicit interaction and monitoring are required.

代理理性和工具使用. Frontier LLM代理(Team, 2026; GLM-5-Team等, 2026; DeepSeek-AI, 2026) 通过工具与外部环境互动,将推理扩展到了静态生成之外(Shen, 2026). 2024; Qu等, 2025.),例如搜索引擎(Jin等, 2025.; Zheng等, 2025.b.),代码译员. (Feng等,2026;Bianchi等,2026;和APIs等,2024;Patil等,2025.).
越来越多的工作通过多回合工具使用轨迹的培训进一步提高了这些能力(Dong等,2025a; Qian等人,2025年),使代理人能够计划,行动,观察,并修改他们的推理(Su等人,2025年;Li等人,2025年c.).
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的代理框架仍然以文字为中心,既用于模型-侧推理,也用于环境-侧互动,在口头说明每个中间步骤时,会引发大量代相传的费用(Cuadron等,2025;Xu等,2025a)。
" 混合代理人 " 使这些作用脱钩,将不断思考的内部推理联系起来,只在需要明确互动和监测的情况下才保留文字。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 8 讨论和未来方向

blocks.en:
Implications for Frontier Agent Safety and Secure Deployment. Frontier labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) provide API-based access to reasoning models while hiding the chain-of-thought from customers to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage, yet Panfilov et al. (2026) show that the encrypted traces returned to clients can be replayed into a sibling model and transcribed verbatim.
HybridAgent places proprietary reasoning on a different footing. Latent thoughts exist only as backbone hidden states that are readable solely through the provider-owned HybridLink (Section 3 ), so no text exists to leak.
The same property aids monitoring. Because the latent trace is held by the provider rather than the client, providers can assess the safety of reasoning and actions over the full readout, including the portion users never see, while the agent benefits from faster inner thinking. Text mode is then reserved for what users legitimately need, such as tool calls, key decisions, and the final answer, preserving an auditable trace without exposing the full reasoning.
blocks.zh:
对边境特工安全和安全部署的影响。 边疆实验室(如OpenAI,Anthropic)提供基于API的推理模型访问,同时向客户隐藏思维链来保护知识产权并限制信息泄露,然而Panfilov等(2026年)显示,归还给客户的加密痕迹可以被重放为一对兄弟模式并被转录为逐字记录.
混合代理人将专有推理置于不同的地位. 后天思想仅作为主干隐藏状态存在,仅通过提供者拥有的HybridLink(第3节)可以读取,因此不存在文字可以泄露.
同样的财产辅助工具监测。 由于潜在的追踪由提供者而不是客户持有,提供者可以评估推理和动作的安全性,而不是完全读取,包括用户从未看到的部分,而代理则从更快的内在思维中获益. 然后,文本模式被保留给用户合法需要的东西,例如工具呼叫,关键决定,以及最后的答案,在不暴露充分推理的情况下保留可审计的痕迹.

blocks.en: Future Directions on Hybrid Agent Harness and Efficient Post-Training. Future work can build a new type of agent harness around HybridAgent, where latent working memory is a first-class component. Context management can then operate on KV entries directly, workflows can schedule steps by mode, keeping tool calls and human-facing checkpoints in text while routine computation stays latent, and one agent’s hybrid trajectory can serve as its message to another. Hybrid generation can also make post-training more efficient. Because latent thoughts remain auditable during rollout, an external critic can assign step-level credit to latent spans, branch promising trajectories, or terminate ones whose latent reasoning has already gone wrong, before any text or tool call is produced.
blocks.zh: 关于混合制剂的管理和高效的后培训的未来方向。 未来的工作可以围绕"混合号"(Hybrid-Agent)构建出一种新型的物剂牵引装置,其中潜伏的工作记忆是一流的组成部分. 然后,背景管理可以直接运行在 KV 条目上, 工作流程可以按模式安排步骤, 在常规计算仍然潜伏的情况下, 将工具呼叫和人形检查点保留在文本中, 一个代理的混合轨迹可以作为它向另一个代理的信息 。 混合型一代还可以使后培训更有效率. 由于潜在想法在推出期间仍然可以审计,外部评论家可以在产生任何文本或工具调用之前,将阶梯级信用分配给潜在跨度、分支有前途的轨迹,或终止那些潜在推理已经出错的轨迹。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce HybridAgent, a unified hybrid reasoning framework that combines efficient latent reasoning with text-based inspection and tool interaction.
HybridAgent enables multi-turn hybrid generation through both architectural designs and dedicated post-training algorithms on SFT and RL stages.
Across 11 benchmarks and 3 model scales, HybridAgent achieves strong performance against advanced LLM agents and agentic frameworks spanning text-based and latent reasoning methods, while substantially reducing inference time, token usage, and computational cost.
Overall, HybridAgent provides a scalable and efficient framework for next-generation agents that can reason beyond human language while retaining agentic interaction in environments and external inspectability.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了“混合代理人”这个统一的混合推理框架,将有效的潜在推理与基于文本的检查和工具互动结合起来。
HybridAgent通过建筑设计和SFT和RL相上的专用后训练算法,可以实现多回合混合生成.
在11个基准和3个模型尺度中, " 混合代理人 " 相对于涵盖基于文字和潜在推理方法的高级LLM代理和代理框架,取得了良好的业绩,同时大大减少了推断时间、象征性使用和计算成本。
总体而言,“混合代理人”为下一代代理人提供了一个可扩展而有效的框架,这些代理人可以超越人类语言进行推理,同时在环境和外部可检查性中保留代理相互作用。

blocks.en: B.1 Why Self-Conditioned Training?
blocks.zh: B.1 为何进行自我培训?

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Train-Inference Mismatch in Latent Reasoning. We illustrate the exposure bias that arises when teacher-forced training meets free-running inference. Left: During activation, the backbone consumes ground-truth embeddings Emb ⁡ ( y ) \mathrm{Emb}(y) at latent positions, while HybridLink outputs ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) are only trained to match their targets and never fed back as inputs. Right: At inference, every latent input is the model’s own ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) , so deviations from the target embeddings accumulate across the span.
blocks.zh: 图11:列车-推论误判在Latent Reasoning. 我们说明,在师资培训满足自由运作推断时,会产生暴露偏差。 左:在激活期间,主干会消耗地上真能嵌入 Emb QQ (y)\mathrm{Emb}(y)在潜入位置上,而HybridLink输出 R QQ (h)\mathcal{R}(h) 只能被训练来匹配目标,从不作为输入反馈. 对: 推论,每个潜在的输入都是模型本身的 R Q( h)\ mathcal{R}(h),因此偏离目标嵌入在整个周期内累积.

blocks.en: The format and HybridLink activation provide a well-aligned initialization, but both are teacher-forced (Figure 11 , left). At every latent position, the backbone consumes the ground-truth embedding Emb ⁡ ( y ) \mathrm{Emb}(y) , and HybridLink is trained only to match its output ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) to that target; the prediction itself is never fed back as an input. At inference, the agent instead runs free (Figure 11 , right). Once it enters latent mode, every subsequent input is its own ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) , which neither the backbone nor HybridLink has been conditioned on. This train-inference mismatch is akin to exposure bias ( Ranzato et al., 2015 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) , a standard issue in autoregressive sequence models that are trained on ground-truth prefixes but consume their own predictions at inference.
blocks.zh: 格式和HybridLink活化提供了一种相通的初始化,但两者都是由教师强制的(图11,左出). 在每一个潜在位置,骨干会消耗嵌入 Emb 的 Emb (y)\mathrm{Emb}(y),而HybridLink只被训练使其输出R → (h)\mathcal{R}(h)与该目标相匹配;预测本身从未被反馈为输入. 推论,代理运行是免费的(图11,右). 一旦它进入了潜伏模式,以后的每一个输入都是自己的R Q (h)\ mathcal{R}(h),而骨干和HybridLink都没有受到这个条件的限制. 这种列车推论不匹配类似于曝光偏差(Ranzato等,2015;Bengio等,2015),这是自旋序列模型中的一个标准问题,通过地面真实前缀培训,但在推论中消耗自己的预测.

blocks.en:
It is worth noting that exposure bias is present in both text and latent modes, since both feed the model’s own outputs back as inputs.
In text mode (as in standard LLM SFT), each fed-back input is sampled and re-embedded, and thus always corresponds to a token in the discrete vocabulary. A prediction error, where the sampled token differs from the ground-truth target, only changes which token is fed back; the input representation itself never leaves the set seen in training, so errors cannot compound in the input space.
Latent mode, in contrast, has no such projection. ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) is continuous and fed back unquantized, so even a small deviation from the target embedding becomes an input the backbone has never seen in training. This deviation propagates to the next hidden state and hence the next latent input, compounding over the tens to hundreds of steps in a latent span and gradually eroding the semantic coherence of the latent trace.
blocks.zh:
值得注意的是,在文本和潜在模式中都存在暴露偏差,因为两者都将模型本身的产出作为投入反馈。
在文本模式(如标准LLM SFT)中,每个feed-back输入都是被采样并被重新嵌入的,因此总是对应离散词汇中的一个符号. 一个预测错误,其中被抽样的指使与地-真实目标不同,只有改变哪个指使被反馈;输入表示本身从不离开训练中看到的集,因此错误不能在输入空间中复合.
相对而言,Latett模式没有这样的投影. R QQ (h )\ mathcal{R}(h)是连续的,并被喂回未分量的,所以即使与入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入 这种偏差传播到下个隐藏状态,从而传播出下个潜在输入,在潜伏的时间内使数十到数百个步骤相加,并逐渐侵蚀了潜在微量的语义一致性.

blocks.en: Self-conditioned HybridSFT closes this gap by training both components on the model’s own generated latent inputs. As in Figure 4 , the teacher-forced first pass applies HybridLink to the last-layer hidden state at each latent position, yielding the model’s own prediction of the next latent input. The second pass then replaces the ground-truth latent embeddings with these predictions and trains the backbone and HybridLink jointly, so both parts learn under the same latent inputs they encounter at inference.
blocks.zh: 自备条件的混合型SFT通过对两个组件进行关于模型本身产生的潜在投入的培训来弥补这一差距。 和图4一样,教师强制的首通将HybridLink应用到每个潜在位置的上一层隐藏状态,从而得出模型自己对下一个潜在输入的预测。 第二次通过之后,用这些预测来取代地上真实的潜在嵌入,并联合训练骨干和HybridLink,因此两部分在他们推断时遇到的同一种潜在投入下学习.

blocks.en: Under this training scheme, the backbone learns to read, and HybridLink learns to produce, latent inputs under the same conditions they encounter at inference. Thus, HybridAgent is trained as an integrated whole rather than two separately activated components.
blocks.zh: 根据这一培训计划,骨干学习阅读,HybridLink学习在他们推断时遇到的同样条件下提供潜在的投入。 因此, " 混合代理人 " 是一个综合整体,而不是两个单独的激活组件。

blocks.en: B.2 Learning When to Enter and Exit Latent Mode
blocks.zh: B.2 学习何时进入和退出后端模式

blocks.en: As stated in Section 3 , HybridAgent transitions between modes through two special tokens, the entry anchor <latent> and the exit anchor </latent> . Within a latent span, these anchors are the only positions supervised by ℒ Backbone \mathcal{L}_{\text{Backbone}} , while every other latent position is supervised by ℒ HybridLink \mathcal{L}_{\text{HybridLink }} alone. The two transitions are not symmetric, however. Entering latent mode is decided in text mode, where the backbone samples the next token from the vocabulary as usual, whereas exiting must be decided from a continuous latent state through the readout in Eq. 5 . HybridSFT therefore treats the entry anchor as an ordinary token and gives the exit anchor dedicated supervision.
blocks.zh: 如第3节所述,混合代理人通过两个特殊符号在模式之间过渡,即条目主锚 " 纬度 " 和退出主锚 "/纬度 " 。 在潜伏的时间内,这些锚是L Backbone\ mathcal{L}_{\text{ Backbone}所监管的唯一位置,而所有其他潜伏位置则由LHybridLink\mathcal{L}_{\text{HybridLink }独自监管. 然而,这两个过渡并不对称。 进入潜入模式在文本模式中被决定,主干线像往常一样从词汇中取出下个符号,而退出则必须通过Eq. 5的读出从连续潜入状态中决定。 因此HybridSFT将入站锚作为普通的代号,并给予出站锚专用监督.

blocks.en: Entry as a Text-Mode Decision. Since entering is a text mode decision, <latent> is simply a cross-entropy target, and the backbone learns from the preceding context when to switch. The anchor position then serves as the first latent step, with its last-layer hidden state passed through HybridLink to produce the next latent input, so the span begins without any additional mechanism.
blocks.zh: 作为文本模式决定的条目。 由于输入是一个文本模式决定,"latent"只是一个跨切入目标,骨干在切换时从上下文中学习. 然后锚位作为第一个潜在的步骤,它的上层隐藏状态通过HybridLink来产生下个潜在的输入,所以跨度开始时没有任何额外的机制.

blocks.en:
Exit as a Latent-Mode Decision. Exiting takes place in latent mode, where no token is sampled. blocks.en:
Adaptive Reasoning on Text and Latent Space. Beyond fixed-length chains of thought, recent work lets LLMs adapt how long and in which medium they reason ( Bigverdi et al., 2024 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , for example by learning when to stop latent reasoning or deciding whether explicit deliberation is needed ( Ning et al., 2025 ) .
Several methods interleave latent reasoning with text decoding ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , using confidence or entropy signals ( Xu et al., 2026 ) to shift into continuous representations at uncertain steps and explore alternative reasoning paths ( Fu and Luo, 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) .
However, existing methods largely operate within one reasoning pass or switch modes only at single-turn granularity, and their latent states remain largely opaque to inspect directly. Orthogonal to this line, HybridAgent uses latent mode for efficient deeper reasoning, carries latent context across multiple turns through continuous working memory, keeps latent thoughts directly readable, and preserves the agentic tool-use abilities for long-horizon tasks.

几种方法将潜在推理与文本解码(Yue等,2025年)相隔开来,使用置信或 en信号(徐等等,2026年),以不确定的步骤转向连续表示并探索其他推理路径(傅等,2026年;史等,2026年).
然而,现有方法基本上在一个推理通过或切换模式范围内运作,只在单回合颗粒性时,其潜在状态基本上仍然不透明,无法直接检查。 与本行正交相通,HybridAgent使用潜伏模式来高效地进行更深层次的推理,通过连续的工作内存在多个转折中承载潜伏上下文,使潜伏的思想能够直接被读取,并保留了能为长距离任务而使用潜伏工具的能力.

blocks.en:
Hybrid Communication among Agents. A recent line of work in multi-agent systems (MAS) parallel to HybridAgent studies hybrid-protocol communication , in which each inter-agent message combines two media. A latent channel carries dense intermediate signals such as hidden states or KV entries, while a text channel carries concise commitments that remain inspectable.
Early instances augment each natural-language message with the sender’s internal state trajectory ( Tang et al., 2025 ) , and later work formalizes the dual-channel design by routing elaborate reasoning through latent vectors while keeping answers and decisions in text ( Mou et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) .
More recent works take the same view from the deployment side, pairing every latent payload with a visible text commitment wherever oversight is required ( Liu, 2026 ) and evaluating the security of latent transfer alongside visible text ( Brito and Baquero, 2026 ) . Complementary to these inter-agent protocols in the MAS setting, HybridAgent decides the medium at the level of each generation step within a single agent, switching between latent reasoning and text-based tool interaction over multi-turn trajectories.
blocks.zh:
特工之间的混合通信。 与HybridAgent研究混合-protocol通信平行的多代理系统(MAS)的近期一行工作,其中每个代理间信息结合了两个介质. 潜入通道带有密密的中间信号,如隐藏状态或KV条目等,而文本通道则带有仍可检查的简洁承诺.
早期的例子通过发送者的内部状态轨迹(Tang等,2025年)来增强每种自然语言的信息,后来的工作通过潜在向量来引导精心推理,同时将答案和决定保留在文字中,从而正式确定双渠道设计(Mou等,2026年;Dai等,2026年)。
近期的作品从部署方面采用了同样的观点,在需要监督的地方将每个潜在有效载荷与可见文本承诺配对(Liu, 2026年)并结合可见文本评估潜在转移的安全性(Brito和Baquero, 2026年)。 作为MAS设置中这些代理协议的补充,HybridAgent在单个代理内每代步骤的级别决定介质,在多转轨迹上在潜在推理和文本工具交互之间切换.

blocks.en: KV-Cache Reuse. Reusing key–value (KV) entries across generation steps is standard practice for efficient serving ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , and recent work extends it across requests, caching shared prefixes and prompt modules ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Juravsky et al., 2024 ) and composing independently encoded caches so that repeated context need not be prefilled again ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . These methods treat the KV cache as an optimization over a context that could in principle be re-encoded from text. HybridAgent likewise builds on the backbone’s own KV entries, using them as a unified working memory that stores and propagates both latent and text information across multi-turn hybrid generation.
blocks.zh: KV- Cache 重用 。 跨生成步骤重用密钥-值(KV)条目是高效服务的标准做法(Kwon等人,2023;Zheng等人,2024),最近的工作将它扩展到各种请求、缓存共享前缀和即时模块(Gim等人,2024;Ye等人,2024;Juravsky等人,2024),并独立编组编码缓存,从而无需再预先填入重复的上下文(Yang等人,2025b; 马等,2025;胡等,2025.). 这些方法将 KV 缓存视为一个在原则上可以从文本中重新编码的上下文之上的优化. HybridAgent同样以主干线本身的KV条目为基础,将这些条目作为统一的工作记忆,在多回合混合生成中存储和传播潜在信息和文本信息。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Hybrid Data Curation Pipeline. We convert text-based demonstrations into multi-turn hybrid trajectories using complementary signals from LLM judgments and model entropy to assign reasoning modes, followed by a visibility audit that preserves decision-critical steps in text mode.

blocks.en:
We curate the hybrid training data by converting existing multi-turn agentic demonstrations ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2025b ) into 54k hybrid trajectories for text and latent supervision.
Specifically, an automatic annotation pipeline is designed to assign each source CoT step to either text or latent mode, based on complementary signals from external LLM judges and the target model’s entropy-based confidence, with no human labeling needed.
Accordingly, high-confidence reasoning steps that the model can handle reliably are assigned as latent targets, while audit-critical reasoning and tool-interaction steps are retained as text targets. We describe the detailed curation pipeline below.
blocks.zh:
我们通过将现有的多回合代理演示(Yu等,2025;Dong等,2025b)转换为54k的混合轨迹来管理混合训练数据,用于文字和潜在监督.
具体来说,一个自动注音管道旨在根据外部LLM判断器的补充信号和目标模型的Entropy信任,将每个源 COT 步骤指定为文本或潜在模式,而不需要人类标签。
因此,该模型能够可靠处理的高度信心推理步骤被指定为潜在目标,而审计关键推理和工具互动步骤被保留为文本目标。 我们描述下面的详细管理管道。

The critic assesses whether the remaining text and tool interactions provide sufficient information to follow the agent’s decisions. When decision-critical information is missing, the corresponding source steps are restored to text mode. This audit helps preserve the key information needed for external debugging and inspection.

This consistency check ensures that the pipeline annotates reasoning modes without rewriting or altering the source demonstrations.

To examine the effectiveness of hybrid reasoning at smaller model scales, we evaluate HybridAgent and corresponding text-based and latent baselines on Qwen3-4B-Base.
As shown in Table 8 , HybridSFT outperforms both latent baselines across all four benchmarks and improves over standard text SFT on AIME25 and AIME26.
HybridRL further improves performance across all four benchmarks, achieving the best results and exceeding ARPO by an average of 2.0 percentage points.
Together with 8B and 14B comparisons in Table 1 and 2 , these results show that the benefits of hybrid reasoning can extend to different model scales of HybridAgent across downstream reasoning tasks.

blocks.en:
Cost Analyses on HybridAgent. To examine whether the efficiency of hybrid generation translates into lower computational cost, we compare HybridAgent with matched text agents across 4B, 8B, and 14B backbones. We estimate decoding compute by charging every text or latent step a full backbone forward pass, together with the cost of vocabulary projection or the HybridLink adapter, respectively. Step counts are averaged over matched evaluations with the same questions, generation budgets, and tool-call limits. We further estimate monetary costs assuming $2.50 per H100-hour and 10% utilization of peak BF16 throughput. These estimates cover generation compute and exclude prompt prefill, context-dependent attention, and external tool execution.
As shown in Table 9 , HybridAgent consistently reduces estimated decoding compute across all three model scales, from 51.2–66.9 TFLOP to 13.9–25.1 TFLOP per question, corresponding to reductions of 62.5%–72.9%. Under the stated pricing and utilization assumptions, the estimated cost of answering one million questions decreases from $359 to $98 at 4B, from $439 to $121 at 8B, and from $470 to $176 at 14B, yielding cost reduction factors of 3.7 × 3.7\times , 3.6 × 3.6\times , and 2.7 × 2.7\times , respectively. Together with the shorter generation trajectories in Figure 6 , these results demonstrate that hybrid reasoning reduces overall decoding compute while explicitly accounting for the backbone computation incurred by latent steps.
blocks.zh:
关于混合代理人的成本分析。 为了检查混合生成的效率是否转化为更低的计算成本,我们比较了HybridAgent与4B,8B,14B等主干线的匹配文本代理. 我们估计解码计算的方法是,向每个文本或潜在步骤充电一个完整的主干前传,以及词汇投影或HybridLink适配器的成本。 步骤计数平均比对具有相同问题、生成预算和工具调用限度的评价。 我们进一步估计,假定每H100小时2.50美元,最高BF16吞吐量利用率为10%,则所涉货币费用为2.50美元。 这些估计包括生成计算,排除了即时预填,上下文依赖的注意,以及外部工具执行.
如表9所显示,混合代理公司将所有三个模型比额表的估计解码计算从51.2至66.9TFLOP降至13.9至25.1TFLOP,相当于每问题减少62.5至72.9%。 根据说明的定价和利用率假设,回答一百万个问题的估计费用从4B的359美元降至98美元,8B的439美元降至121美元,14B的470美元降至176美元,费用削减系数分别为:3.7×3.7分;3.6×3.6分;2.7×2.7分。 与图6中较短的生成轨迹一起,这些结果表明,混合推理降低了整体解码计算,同时明确计入了由潜在步骤引起的主干计算.

AIME 25 ( math-ai, 2025 ) :
AIME 25 comprises 30 problems from the 2025 American Invitational Mathematics Examination, covering algebra, geometry, number theory, and combinatorics.
Its integer-answer problems evaluate competition-level mathematical reasoning, requiring models to combine mathematical insights with precise multi-step calculations.
blocks.zh:
AIME 25 (数学-ai, 2025) :
AIME 25由2025年美国邀请数学考试的30个问题组成,涵盖代数,几何学,数字理论,和组合论.
其整数答题评价竞争层面的数学推理,需要模型将数学洞察力与精确多步骤计算相结合.

blocks.en:
AIME 26 ( MathArena, 2026 ) :
AIME 26 contains 30 problems from the 2026 American Invitational Mathematics Examination, following the same competition format as AIME 25.
It provides a complementary assessment of mathematical problem solving across a separate annual problem set, testing sustained reasoning and accurate numerical derivation.
blocks.zh:
AIME 26 (MathArena, 2026) : (英语).
AIME 26包含2026年美国邀请数学考试的30个问题,遵循与AIME 25.相同的竞争格式.
它提供了对不同年度问题的数学问题解决的补充评估,测试持续推理和准确的数字推导。

blocks.en:
MATH500 ( HuggingFaceH4, 2023 ) :
MATH500 is a 500-problem subset of the MATH test set, spanning 7 mathematical subjects and 5 difficulty levels.
It evaluates math reasoning across diverse problem types, including symbolic manipulation, geometric deduction, and numerical computation.
blocks.zh:
MATH500 (HuggingFaceH4, 2023) (英语:
MATH500是MATH测试集的一个500个问题子集,跨越了7个数学主题和5个难度级别.
它评价各种问题类型的数学推理,包括象征性地操纵,几何取舍,和数字计算.

blocks.en: (ii) Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning Tasks
blocks.zh: (二)知识强化合理任务.

blocks.en:
GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) :
GPQA-Diamond is a curated subset of 198 expert-written multiple-choice questions in biology, physics, and chemistry.
Selected through expert and non-expert validation, these questions assess advanced scientific knowledge and reasoning that remain challenging for non-experts even with web access.
blocks.zh:
GPQA-Diamond(Rein等人,2023年) :
GPQA-Diamond是一个由生物学,物理学和化学方面的198个专家写作多选题组成的被整理的子集.
这些问题通过专家和非专家验证选定,对高级科学知识和推理进行评估,即使有网络访问,对非专家来说,这些知识和推理仍然具有挑战性。

blocks.en:
MedQA ( Yang et al., 2024 ) :
MedQA is a multiple-choice question-answering benchmark derived from professional medical licensing examinations. The dataset contains 300 questions in total.
Its questions assess medical knowledge and clinical reasoning, requiring models to interpret patient information and identify appropriate diagnoses, investigations, or treatments.
blocks.zh:
MedQA (Yang等, 2024年) :
医疗 QA是专业医疗许可考试中衍生出来的多选择问答基准. 该数据集共包含300个问题.
它的问题评估医学知识和临床推理,要求模型解释患者信息并找出适当的诊断,调查或治疗.

blocks.en:
MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) :
MuSiQue is a multi-hop question-answering benchmark constructed by composing single-hop questions into connected reasoning chains of two to four hops.
It evaluates the ability to combine evidence across multiple passages, with question construction designed to reduce shortcuts that bypass intermediate reasoning steps. Following Dong et al. (2025b) , we use 200 test-set questions for downstream evaluation across all methods.
blocks.zh:
MuSiQue (Trivedi等, 2022年) :
MuSiQue是一个多跳问答基准,通过将单跳问题组合入由2到4个跳的连接推理链来构建.
它评价了跨多段路段综合证据的能力,问题构建旨在减少绕过中间推理步骤的快捷键. 继董等(2025年b)后,我们使用200个测试集的问题进行下游评价,涵盖所有方法.

blocks.en: (iii) Agentic Reasoning Tasks
blocks.zh: (三)代理原因任务.

blocks.en:
General AI Assistants (GAIA) ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) :
GAIA evaluates general-purpose assistants on real-world questions involving reasoning, web browsing, information processing, and external tool use.
Its three difficulty levels reflect increasingly demanding combinations of reasoning steps and tool interactions, assessing the ability to coordinate these capabilities toward a verifiable answer.
blocks.zh:
一般人工智能助理(GAIA)(Mialon等人,2024年):
GAIA在涉及推理,网络浏览,信息处理,以及外部工具使用等现实世界问题上评价通用助手.
其三个难度水平反映了推理步骤和工具互动之间日益需要的组合,评估了协调这些能力以可核查的答案的能力。

blocks.en:
Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) ( Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) :
HLE comprises expert-authored questions across a broad range of academic disciplines, including mathematics, natural sciences, and the humanities.
Its multiple-choice and short-answer problems assess advanced subject knowledge and reasoning on questions designed to resist quick answers through direct web retrieval.
blocks.zh:
人类的最后考试(HLE)(AI安全中心等,2026年):
法学硕士由专家撰写的涉及数学、自然科学和人文科学等广泛学术学科的问题组成。
它的多选择和短答问题评估了高级主题知识和对问题推理,旨在通过直接网络检索来抵制快速解答.

blocks.en:
WebWalker ( Wu et al., 2025 ) :
WebWalkerQA, referred to as WebWalker in our evaluations, is an agentic search benchmark requiring exploration of website subpages and integration of information from one or multiple sources.
Its easy, medium, and hard categories reflect increasing traversal depth, testing the ability to locate and synthesize evidence beyond surface-level search results.
blocks.zh:
WebWalker (Wu等, 2025年) :
WebWalkerQA在我们的评价中称为WebWalker,是一个代理搜索基准,需要探索网站分页,并从一个或多个来源整合信息.
其简单、中和硬的分类反映了越来越深,测试在地表一级搜索结果之外找到和综合证据的能力。

blocks.en:
SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) :
SealQA evaluates search-augmented question answering on factual questions for which retrieved information may be noisy, conflicting, or unhelpful.
We evaluate on Seal-0 and Seal-Hard, which test factual accuracy and reasoning under challenging retrieval conditions.
Seal-0 targets questions selected for near-zero accuracy among the non-reasoning models used during benchmark construction; Seal-Hard includes a broader collection of difficult questions.
blocks.zh:
SealQA (Pham等人, 2026年) :
SealQA评价搜索回答的事实问题,所检索的信息可能吵闹、相冲突或无济于事。
我们评价Seal-0和Seal-Hard,它们测试在挑战性检索条件下的事实准确性和推理。
Seal-0目标问题在基准构建中使用的非合理模型中选取近于零的准确性; Seal-Hard包括更广泛的难题集.

blocks.en:
DeepSearchQA (DSQA) ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) :
DeepSearchQA evaluates multi-step web research through tasks that require assembling complete answer sets from information distributed across sources.
It tests search planning, evidence aggregation, entity disambiguation, and the ability to determine when sufficient information has been collected.
We report both full-correct rate and F1 score to assess complete task success and the balance between answer precision and coverage.
blocks.zh:
DeepSearchQA (DSQA)(Gupta等, 2026年) :
深搜索 质量评估通过需要从不同来源的信息中收集完整答案组的任务来评价多步骤网络研究。
它检验搜索规划、证据汇总、实体混淆以及确定何时收集了足够信息的能力。
我们报告完全正确的比率和F1的分数,以评估任务完成情况以及答案精确度和覆盖面之间的平衡。

blocks.en: H.2 Baseline Details
blocks.zh: H.2 基线细节

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of HybridAgent, we compare with 4 categories of methods, including (i) Text-based Agentic Methods, (ii) Latent Reasoning Methods, (iii) Frontier LLM Agents, and (iv) Agentic Frameworks. We describe the implementation details of each baseline below.
blocks.zh: 为了评价混合代理人的效力和效率,我们比较了4类方法,包括(一) 以文字为基础的代理方法,(二) 后期理性方法,(三) 边界LLM代理人,(四) 代理框架。 我们叙述以下每个基准的执行细节。

blocks.en: (i) Text-based Agentic Methods
blocks.zh: (一) 文本代理 方法

blocks.en: Standard Text SFT : We apply standard SFT using the same training data and backbone models as HybridAgent. During evaluation, the models can invoke tools and incorporate the returned observations into subsequent reasoning. We use this baseline mostly to compare with the HybridSFT.
blocks.zh: 标准文本 SFT:我们使用与HybridAgent相同的训练数据和主干模型应用了标准SFT. 在评价期间,模型可以引用工具,并将返回的观察纳入后续推理. 我们使用这一基线主要是为了与SFT混合系统进行比较。

blocks.en: Agentic RL (GRPO/ARPO) : We apply commonly adopted agentic RL methods after standard text SFT to further train the text agent baselines. GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) optimizes the policy using group-normalized rewards from sampled responses without requiring a separate critic. ARPO ( Dong et al., 2025b ) : ARPO combines entropy-guided adaptive rollouts with step-level advantage attribution to improve multi-turn tool use. We train these methods using the same RL training data and backbone models as HybridAgent, primarily to evaluate the effectiveness of HybridRL.
blocks.zh: 代理RL(GRPO/ARPO): 在标准文本SFT之后,我们采用常用的代理RL方法来进一步训练文本代理基线. GRPO(Shao等,2024年)利用从被抽样的回复中获得的团体常态化奖励来优化政策,而不需要单独的批评者. ARPO (Dong等, 2025b):ARPO结合了Entropy-guided 适应性推出与分级优势归属,来改进多回合工具的使用. 我们使用与混合动力相同的RL训练数据和主干模型来培训这些方法,主要是为了评估混合动力的有效性.

blocks.en: (ii) Latent Reasoning Methods
blocks.zh: (二) 后期理由 方法

blocks.en: Coconut ( Hao et al., 2024 ) : Coconut performs continuous latent reasoning by directly feeding the model’s last hidden state back as the next input embedding. A staged training curriculum progressively replaces textual reasoning steps with latent thoughts, teaching the model to reason in continuous space before generating a textual answer.
blocks.zh: Coconut (Hao等, 2024年) : Coconut通过直接将模型上一个隐藏状态反馈回作为下个输入嵌入来来进行连续潜入推理. 分阶段的培训课程逐步用潜在思想取代文字推理步骤,在生成文字答案之前,在连续空间中教导模型理性。

blocks.en: SoftCoT ( Xu et al., 2025b ) : SoftCoT uses a lightweight frozen assistant model to generate question-dependent soft thought representations, which a trainable projection maps into the target LLM’s representation space. These representations guide subsequent generation, enabling latent reasoning while keeping the assistant and target LLM frozen.
blocks.zh: SoftCoT(徐等,2025年b): SoftCoT使用轻量级冷冻助理模型来生成以问题为依托的柔性思维表示,可被训练出投影图入入目标LLM的表示空间. 这些表述指导了以后的生成,使得潜在的推理成为可能,同时使助手和目标LLM被冻结.

blocks.en: SoftThinking ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) : SoftThinking is a context-based method that represents intermediate reasoning as probability-weighted mixtures of vocabulary embeddings. Feeding these hidden continuous representations back into the model preserves alternatives from the next-token distribution.
blocks.zh: 软想 (张等,2025年: SoftThink是一种基于上下文的方法,它代表了中间推理作为词汇嵌入的概率加权混合物. 将这些隐藏的连续表示物放回模型中,可以保存下个接吻分布的替代品.

blocks.en: We implement all latent reasoning baselines using the same backbone models and, where applicable, training settings and budgets as HybridAgent to ensure a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 我们采用同样的主干模式实施所有潜在推理基线,并在适用的情况下,采用作为混合机构的培训环境和预算,以确保公平比较。

blocks.en: (iii) Frontier LLM Agents
blocks.zh: (三) 边境LLM代理人

blocks.en: To evaluate HybridAgent in a broader context, we compare it with current leading closed-source and open-source LLM agents, including GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Team, 2026 ) , GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM-5-Team and others, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and QwQ-32B ( Team, 2025 ) , to assess both performance and inference efficiency of HybridAgent.
blocks.zh: 为了在更广泛的背景下评价混合代理,我们将它与目前领先的闭源和开源LLM代理进行比较,包括GPT-5.6-Luna(OpenAI,2026年),Kimi-K3(Team,2026年),GLM-5.3-Flash(GLM-5-Team等,2026年),DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(DeepSeek-AI,2026年)和QwQ-32B(Team,2025年),以评估混合代理的性能和推论效率.

blocks.en: (iv) Agentic Frameworks
blocks.zh: (四)代理框架.

blocks.en: We further compare HybridAgent with established agentic frameworks that integrate multi-step reasoning with external tool calling and environmental interactions. We apply Qwen3-14B as the backbone for all these frameworks, with the same tool access and usage budgets as HybridAgent.
blocks.zh: 我们还将“混合代理人”与将多步骤推理与外部工具呼叫和环境互动相结合的既定代理框架进行比较。 我们采用Qune3-14B作为所有这些框架的骨干,其工具访问和使用预算与混合代理人相同。

blocks.en: ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) : ReAct interleaves natural-language reasoning with actions and observations from an external environment. This interaction loop allows an agent to gather information, revise its reasoning, and determine subsequent actions based on tool feedback.
blocks.zh: ReAct (姚等, 2023) (中文(简体) ). ReAct将自然语言推理与外部环境的动作和观察进行交互. 这种交互循环允许一个代理收集信息,修改其推理,并根据工具反馈确定后续行动.

blocks.en: Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) : Search-o1 augments large reasoning models with adaptive search to address knowledge gaps encountered during reasoning. Its Reason-in-Documents module analyzes retrieved documents and extracts relevant evidence before incorporating it into ongoing reasoning.
blocks.zh: 搜索-o1(Li等,2025a): 搜索-o1通过适应性搜索增强大型推理模型,以弥补推理过程中遇到的知识差距. 它的文件理由模块分析检索到的文件并取出相关证据,然后将其纳入正在进行的推理。

blocks.en: WebThinker ( Li et al., 2025b ) : WebThinker equips LLMs with a Deep Web Explorer that supports iterative search, webpage navigation, and information extraction. Its Think-Search-and-Draft strategy interleaves reasoning, evidence collection, and report generation to support complex research tasks.
blocks.zh: WebThinker (Li等, 2025年b:) : WebThinker为LLMs配备了支持迭代搜索,网页导航以及信息提取的深层Web探索器. 它的"思索-搜索-和-草案"战略交互了推理,证据收集,和报告生成,以支持复杂的研究任务.

blocks.en: Overall, these baseline methods provide complementary comparisons across training stages, text-based and latent-space reasoning, and tool-integrated agentic settings.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些基线方法在培训阶段、基于文本的和潜在的空间推理以及综合工具代理设置之间提供了互补的比较。

blocks.en: H.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: H.3 实施细节

blocks.en:
Models and Training Details. We instantiate HybridAgent with Qwen3-Base backbones ( Yang et al., 2025a ) at three scales of 4B, 8B, and 14B.
For HybridLink, we use the same two-layer design across all three backbones. The HybridSFT training data is constructed by converting 54K text-only sources ( Dong et al., 2025a ; Dong et al., 2025b ) into hybrid trajectories. We apply format and HybridLink activation for one epoch each, followed by one additional epoch of self-conditioned training. HybridRL training utilizes 12K deep reasoning examples ( Yu et al., 2025 ) for math and 1K agentic reasoning and search examples ( Dong et al., 2025b ) for deep search.
We train HybridAgent with the GRPO objective and set rollout batches of 512 trajectories ( 64 × 8 64\times 8 ), followed by one optimization pass over 8 minibatches.
blocks.zh:
模式与培训细节. 我们以4B、8B和14B三个比例点,利用Qune3-Base骨干(Yang等,2025a)即时混合代理。
对于HybridLink,我们使用相同的两层设计,跨越所有三个骨干. HybridSFT培训数据是通过转换54K只使用文本的源来构建的(Dong等,2025a; Dong等,2025b)入杂交道. 我们采用格式和HybridLink激活每个时代,然后再加一个自我条件训练的时代。 HybridRL培训利用了数学方面的12K深层推理实例(Yu等人,2025年)和1K代理推理和搜索实例(Dong等人,2025年b)进行深度搜索。
我们用GRPO目标训练混合特工,并设定出512个出道分批(64×8 64\times 8),然后一个优化通过8个小管.

(2025) , we use HybridAgent checkpoints from deep reasoning training for mathematical evaluations and the checkpoint from agentic search training for knowledge-intensive search and agentic reasoning evaluations, as detailed in Appendix H.1 .
blocks.zh: 训练超参数。 表10、11和12提供了SFT和HybridRL的详细参数设置。 追随董等 (2025年b). Yu等人(2025年),我们使用来自深层推理训练的混合代理检查站进行数学评价,而来自用于知识密集型搜索和代理推理评价的代理搜索训练的代理检查站,详见附录H.1.

blocks.en:
Inference Setups. During inference, we set the temperature, top-p, and top-k to 0.6, 0.95, and 20, respectively. The generation budget is adjusted for each task based on its relative difficulty and counts both text tokens and latent steps, with limits of 4,096 for mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive search tasks, and 24,000 for challenging agentic reasoning tasks.
For each latent span, we enforce a minimum of 16 and a maximum of 256 steps to ensure sustained and semantically rich latent reasoning.
HybridAgent interacts with external environments primarily through two types of tools: a Python interpreter within sandbox environments and a live search engine (e.g., Tavily).
We cap tool usage at 10 calls per trajectory and retrieve the top 10 snippets for each search query.
We utilize GPT-5.6-Luna as both the search-page summarizer and LLM judge.
All training and inference are conducted on 32 H100 GPUs. We also provide detailed prompt templates in Appendix I .
blocks.zh:
推论设置. 在推论期间,我们把温度,上-p和上-k分别设定为0.6,0.95和20. 每项任务的生成预算根据其相对难度而作调整,计算出文本符号和潜在步骤,数学推理和知识密集型搜索任务的限额为4 096个,挑战代理推理任务的限额为24 000个。
对于每一个潜在阶段,我们实施至少16个步骤和最多256个步骤,以确保持续和充满潜力的潜在推理。
HybridAgent主要通过两种工具与外部环境相互作用:沙盒环境中的Python解释器和活搜索引擎(如Tavily).
我们按每个轨迹10次调用工具, 并检索每个搜索查询的前10个片段。
我们利用GPT-5.6-Luna作为网页摘要和LLM法官。
所有培训和推论都是在32个H100GPU上进行的. 我们还在附录一中提供了详细的即时模板。

blocks.en:
Infrastructure and Configurations. As existing training and inference frameworks such as verl ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) and vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) do not directly support multi-turn hybrid generation, we extend their infrastructure to enable hybrid training and generation in HybridAgent.
A shared generation loop coordinates text mode, latent mode, and tool interaction while maintaining each trajectory’s persistent KV cache as continuous working memory across turns.
The agent enters latent mode through the special entry anchor <latent> , feeds HybridLink-generated latent inputs back into the backbone, and returns to text mode when the nearest-token readout matches the exit anchor </latent> , as in Eq. 5 . Tool observations are tokenized and processed against the existing working memory, appending new KV entries without reconstructing or re-prefilling earlier context.
blocks.zh:
基础设施和配置。 由于现有的培训和推论框架如verl(Sheng等,2025年)和vLLM(Kwon等,2023年)并不直接支持多回合混合生成,因此我们扩展了它们的基础设施,以便能够混合培训和混合代理生成.
共享生成回路坐标文本模式、潜在模式和工具交互,同时将每个轨迹的持久 KV 缓存作为连续的工作内存保存。
代理通过特殊条目主锚"纬度"进入潜伏模式,将HybridLink生成的潜在输入反馈到主干线,当最接近的读出与退出主锚"/纬度"匹配时返回文本模式,如Eq. 5. 工具观察会针对现有的工作内存进行标识和处理,附加新的KV条目而无需重建或再预置更早的上下文.

blocks.en: The engine also supports batched rollouts with per-sequence state tracking, allowing trajectories to occupy different generation states within the same batch. Pending tool calls execute concurrently, with waiting and completed sequences masked from further generation. Per-sequence attention masks and position tracking preserve each trajectory’s causal context as generation proceeds. For HybridRL, exact latent-context replay recomputes sampled text-token likelihoods in a single differentiable forward pass while keeping recorded latent inputs unchanged. We check rollout–replay agreement of log-probabilities at unchanged policy parameters. Multi-node data parallelism, sharded optimizer states, mixed precision, gradient checkpointing, and resumable checkpoints support full-parameter backbone optimization. Overall, the same engine supports RL rollouts, training-time validation, and downstream evaluation, ensuring consistent mode transitions and working-memory handling across configurable sampling settings, generation budgets, and tool-call setups.
blocks.zh: 发动机还支持分批推出并按顺序进行状态跟踪,使轨迹能够占据同批次内不同的生成状态. 等待工具呼叫同时执行,等待和完成的序列被后一代掩盖. 序列的注意面罩和位置跟踪在生成过程中保留了每个轨道的因果背景. 对于HybridRL,精确的潜伏文本重放在单个可分辨的前进通道中重新计算所取取出文本键的可能性,同时保持所记录的潜在输入不变. 我们以不变的政策参数检查日志概率的推出-重放协议。 多节点数据平行化,硬化优化状态,混合精度,梯度检查,和可复用检查站支持全参数骨干优化. 总体而言,同一引擎支持RL的推出、培训时间验证和下游评价,确保不同可配置抽样环境、生成预算和工具调用设置之间一致的模式过渡和工作记忆处理。
